billy-inf.feature.cs.configuration-locke: Makes ConfigurationLocker treat every config item as unlocked (isLocked returns false, getValueLocked returns null). Combined with 'Disable Apply All' this bypasses server config locking entirely.
Disables ConfigurationLocker.applyAll so locked values are no longer force-written to the active config. Only blocks replay; does not clear the 'modification forbidden' flag.
billy-inf.action.cs.configuration-locker: Calls ConfigurationLocker.setAuthorized to unlock the given paths, simulating server authorization. Accepts multiple paths at once.
Calls ConfigurationLocker.setLocked to lock and immediately replay path=value. Omitting the value means lock without a forced value.
Calls ConfigurationLocker.enterServerLock to lock the default protected config (awaiting authorization). No arguments.
Calls ConfigurationLocker.leaveServerLock to clear all lock entries and restore free config. No arguments.
